name: Interactive Concave Volume Clipping via GPU Boolean Operations
aliases: GPU Ray Casting with Boolean Clipping
definition: A method to display inner structures of volumetric datasets by performing interactive concave volume clipping using Boolean operations (intersection, subtraction, union) implemented on the GPU, avoiding the need for complex transfer functions.
summary: Interactive Concave Volume Clipping via GPU Boolean Operations enables interactive visualization of inner structures by decomposing 3D Boolean operations into 1D ray-based logic, supporting concave volumes with minimal video memory.
